in_marathi.name: Gautama
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seer, Wise One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gautama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has seen the truth. A sage or seer in Hindu mythology, known as the founder of Buddhism.

in_bengali.name: Gautama
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Seer, Wise One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gautama একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has seen the truth. A sage or seer in Hindu mythology, known as the founder of Buddhism.
